verification: Source: download_file_content returned base64. Python decoded it in memory from a heredoc on stdin, and no copy of the content was written to disk. The decoded length is 31,923 B, matching Drive's fileSize. Two independent decodes gave the same sha256 above. An earlier decode was 31,915 B because of an 8-byte transcription slip; the size check caught it and it was discarded. The hash therefore rests on an in-context transcription of the payload, and EXECUTE must recompute it from its own download. A mismatch means the file changed or this transcription erred: stop and re-read. Checks on the text: valid UTF-8; LF only; no control characters; non-ASCII outside the fence limited to – — “ ”. The structure matches NOTES: 8 links outside the fence, and 7 H2, 21 H3 and 12 links inside it. Split at the fence (lines 119-286), each old string occurs exactly once outside the fence. M2-R1 to R8 are before the fence and M2-R9 is after it; M2-R3 also occurs once inside the fence and must not be replaced there. Applying all 9 replacements (first occurrence, outside-fence segments only) left the fence byte-identical. It left no line outside the fence naming Drive and added 3 {{CANDIDATE_CRD_LIST_URL}} links (M2-R4, R5, R9), taking links outside the fence from 8 to 11. Notes for EXECUTE: (1) The page's own URL does not exist before notion-create-pages. A literal '({{CANDIDATE_CRD_LIST_URL}})' link target is not a valid URL and Notion may reject it or drop it. Create the page with those 3 spots as plain text 'Candidate CRD Items List'. Then, after URL normalization (step 7), make them links with one notion-update-page call and read back. Check that no '{{' is left. (2) The readback criteria need M2 amendments. F6 becomes 11 (link text, target) pairs, including 3 self-links to the new page id. F9 already exempts the M2 rewrites and bullet. F8 is 2 + 1 bullets. The callout adds no link. (3) {{EXECUTE_DATE}} appears in M2-R1, the revision bullet and the callout.
